releases.title: Parry uses click and F
changes: Parry uses left click and F, with accurate time-to-impact prediction
Time-to-impact is recomputed every tick from the live ball speed and your position, and live ping stays in the lead
Curves follow the ball's real velocity toward you. Long shots and clash returns each send one click and one F tap, only inside the lead window

releases.title: Parry restored to first auto-parry
changes: Blade Ball auto parry was restored to the first published auto-parry behavior (v1.2.4 style)
Clicks use predicted time-to-impact on the real physics ball, and long-range shots click only inside the lead window
Fast clashes start from the nearest opponent's distance; slow balls close to you are not clicked early
Delivery-delay learning, clash pre-fire, walk-in, roster check, rescue clicks, and the later window shrinking are not in this build
Roblox offsets, skybox, weather, Steal An Egg, AI Follow, and admin are unchanged

releases.title: Exact timing, no spam, one click per arrival
changes: Removed clash ahead prediction to prevent pre-fires and double clicks
Ensures exactly one click is sent precisely on time per approach or clash return
Prevents swinging early on far balls

releases.title: Parry: roster check, no wasted clash clicks, walk-in
changes: Clash returns are only clicked when the ball's line reaches you before any other player in the arena, so a ball sent past you to someone else is never parried
A clash click timed through the opponent's return only fires if the ball is actually flying into that opponent; a click for a return that never comes would whiff and put parry on its 2 s cooldown
Walking into a slow or resting ball that targets you now gets its one on-time click (only within a few studs and while you close in)
Still one click per approach and per clash return, no spam, no early swing on long balls; tracking, Auto Ping and the measured window are unchanged

releases.title: Parry: one on-time click per clash return
changes: Clashes of any range get one on-time click per return; normal balls stay one click and not early
Clash is detected on the first rally half from the nearest opponent's distance and the ball's trip back at its current speed; no waiting for retargets

In a clash the click for each return is timed through the opponent: time for the ball to reach them plus the trip back, against live ping + delivery + margin, so fast returns are no longer clicked too late
Each return is its own approach: the reflect away from you re-arms on that tick (velocity flip or a receding frame), and one arrival can never get two clicks
A return heading back at you counts as yours right away, even before the ball's target updates
Spam Rate still caps clash clicks but never holds back a real return
Long balls that aren't clashes keep the same single on-time click
Overlay shows CLASH with the return time next to the window

releases.title: Parry: tracking and one on-time click together
changes: Tracking and the single on-time click now work together: parry clicks again when the ball reaches the window, still one click, still not early

The window now includes the delivery delay (the click waiting for Roblox's input frame plus how far behind the server the ball we read is), which v1.2.13 left out, so its clicks arrived after the ball had already hit
Delivery is measured live from your own parries (click to reflect seen, minus ping) and starts from a small estimate until two parries are measured; no fixed 160-300 ms margin
If the lock drops just as the ball closes in, a window crossed between ticks still gets its one click
Still one click per approach, no rescue click; re-arms only after the ball leaves and comes back
Status and overlay show ARMED / HELD and the window split into ping + delivery + margin

releases.title: Parry: one click per approach, no early swing
changes: One click per approach: no follow-up or rescue click, so parry never clicks twice and misses
No early swing: the click window is now live ping + one input delay + a small speed margin (25-75 ms), nothing more
Timing comes from live ping and ball speed on every tick; a speed-up from a hit changes time-to-impact that tick
A new click is only allowed after the ball actually leaves (its own motion away from you, distance growing) and comes back
Target flicker, backing away from the ball, or a curve no longer re-arm the same approach
If the ball will reach you before Roblox's next frame plus input delay, that tick is the click
Ping uses the median of the last ~1 s in Auto and manual mode (one spike ignored, a real change applies in under a second); the 300 ms cap is gone
Overlay shows tti next to the window broken into ping + input + margin

releases.title: Ball tracking: locked on, never behind
changes: Ball tracking stays locked on the real physics ball for the whole flight and no longer falls behind fast balls
A reflect is tracked on the tick the ball's physics velocity flips, up to a frame before its position shows it
A hit that more than doubles the ball's speed is picked up on that tick instead of a frame later
A speed jump from a hit no longer counts as acceleration, so the predicted impact isn't pulled early
A destroyed or replaced ball is dropped on that tick and the new one is found within a few milliseconds
The 0-velocity visual copy can't steal the lock during a freeze or when the real ball is briefly slow
A single failed attribute read no longer drops the real ball or its target
Clicks still wait for time-to-impact inside the parry window: better tracking never means an earlier click

releases.title: Parry timing: no early clicks, no missed windows
changes: Parry no longer clicks early and no longer misses the window on long shots, clashes, and curves
Every click waits until the predicted time-to-impact is inside the parry window, clash mode included
Clash no longer spams while the ball is on the opponent's side: one click per approach, paced by Spam Rate
Ping lead is capped at 300 ms and mis-read ping values are ignored, so Auto Ping can't fire while the ball is still far
The speed jump from a hit or reflect no longer counts as acceleration, which made the prediction click early
A ball that reaches you before the next frame plus input delay gets one click on that tick; a leaving ball is never clicked
If a click could not have landed and the ball is still coming, one rescue click follows (never a second click on a curve)

releases.title: Parry click timing fix, live Auto Ping, realistic skies
changes: Blade Ball click timing fixed for long shots, short clashes and fast clashes. It still does not click early: a normal approach clicks once, when time to impact enters the click window

Short clashes: a fast rally with a nearby opponent counts as a clash from the first bounce (it no longer waits for two retargets) and stays covered while the ball is on the opponent's side, so the return is not late
Fast clashes and reflects: right after a reflect the parry uses the ball's real velocity on that same frame instead of a slow half-frame reading, so fast returns are no longer timed late
One click per approach: a ball only counts as deflected after it has moved away for about two frames, so a curving ball can't trigger a second click

Live Auto Ping: with Auto Ping on, the click lead follows your current ping (1-second median, updated continuously). Higher ping clicks a bit earlier, lower ping clicks closer to impact, and the status line shows the ping in use. With Auto Ping off, the manual ping sliders work as before
Parry input stays left click: a memory-based parry was not added because Oxide has no proven way to write Roblox mouse or key input in memory
Realistic sky presets: Clear Day, Sunset, Overcast, Stormy Sea, Moonlit Night, Harvest Moon, Deep Space, Purple Galaxy

Match Lighting (on by default): a sky preset also sets time of day and ambient light to fit it, and restores them when the sky is turned off. Clear Haze now thins the atmosphere instead of removing it. Custom six-ID skyboxes still override presets

releases.title: Blade Ball parry tracks movement, faster reaction
changes: Blade Ball auto parry now recalculates every tick while you move, strafe, jump or turn, so the click stays on your contact circle. The circle is centered on your character, so turning never shifts it
It does not click early: it clicks when time to impact enters the click window (speed lead + ping + input delay)

Faster reaction: when a ball gets close to your click window, the parry loop checks about 4 times per millisecond instead of once, so the click goes out the moment the window opens. Targeting is re-checked every 5 ms and a new ball is picked up within 50 ms

If the curved path would miss only because you stepped aside, it re-aims at where you are now instead of dropping the lock. If it still can't lock, it uses the old time-to-impact timing. Straight shots time exactly as before
Late backstop: if the ball would reach you before the next frame plus input delay and no click has gone out yet, it clicks once. It never clicks at a ball that is leaving
Visualize shows LOCK or fallback next to tti and window

releases.title: Steal An Egg egg picker
changes: Steal An Egg egg picker: pick a specific egg from the list and Oxide teleports you on top of it, holds E to grab it, teleports you back to your base and left-clicks to place it on your farm. With nothing picked it keeps looping through the other eggs
Steal An Egg tab: egg ESP, auto steal and egg lock, now using the game's real object names from a live tree dump

Blade Ball curved prediction: auto parry follows the ball's curved path to your contact circle and times the click from that. Straight shots time exactly as before, and it falls back to the old estimate when it can't lock. Curve Aware turns it on or off
Blade Ball AI Follow: walks you to the nearest living player, stays on them until they're out, then moves to the next. WASD pauses it
Custom Skybox fix: preset and custom skies now actually show in Roblox. Oxide makes Roblox reload the sky after swapping the textures
Rain and Snow: weather effects around your camera, on your screen only. Turning one on turns the other off
Dump tree: button in the General tab or the Steal An Egg tab that saves the current game's object tree to %AppData%\OXIDE\cache\tree.txt, for support and bug reports
This build replaces v1.2.5, which shipped before the egg picker was finished

releases.title: Curved parry, Steal An Egg, skybox fix
changes: Blade Ball curved prediction: auto parry now follows the ball's curved path to your contact circle and times the click from that, so curve shots stop dying late or clicking early. Straight shots time exactly as before, and it falls back to the old estimate when it can't lock. Curve Aware turns it on or off
Blade Ball AI Follow: new toggle that walks you to the nearest living player, stays on them until they're out, then moves to the next. WASD pauses it
Custom Skybox fix: preset and custom skies now actually show in Roblox. Oxide now makes Roblox reload the sky after swapping the textures
Rain and Snow: new weather effects around your camera, on your screen only. Turning one on turns the other off
Steal An Egg: new game tab with player and egg ESP, auto steal, egg lock (closest egg) and a speed boost
Dump tree: new button in the General tab or the Steal An Egg tab that saves the current game's object tree to %AppData%\OXIDE\cache\tree.txt, for support and bug reports

releases.title: Auto parry timing rework
changes: Blade Ball auto parry: now tracks the real ball (the physics part in workspace.Balls) instead of the visual copy
Blade Ball auto parry: uses the ball's live physics velocity, including right after a reflect or freeze
Blade Ball auto parry: long-range shots only click once the predicted time-to-impact is inside your lead window, not as soon as the ball starts far away
Blade Ball auto parry: fast clashes start from the nearest opponent's distance and the rally round-trip, with the lead scaled to ball speed
Blade Ball auto parry: slow balls close to you are no longer clicked early
Blade Ball auto parry: input delay always accounts for at least one frame, so low FPS is less late
Da Hood auto parry: replaced the flat 180 ms click timer with arrival prediction
Da Hood auto parry: clicks once when a melee player facing you is predicted to reach you (uses both your velocity and theirs). Someone standing still at range is ignored
Toggles, keybinds, and existing sliders are unchanged

Added lowercase letter support for keybinds
